supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s name parts of a whole.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Partition shapes into 2, 3, 4, 6, or 8 parts with equal area and name those parts as halves, thirds, fourths, sixths, and eighths. Recognize that equal-size parts in a shape can be named with numbers called fractions.
teachingSteps: Identify the whole and divide it into equal parts.
Represent the fraction with a number line or equal-area drawing.
Explain the unit fractions, position, equality or comparison.
